purpose: Provenance and review record for the illustrative service photos on provider profiles (TRACE-156 P2C).

displayRules.label: Illustrative service photo
displayRules.crop: Fixed crop around each asset's focal point, generated ahead of time as WebP
displayRules.fallback: If the image fails, the whole panel is removed. The provider's own media and the offer are unaffected.
displayRules.altText: Describes the photo and begins with 'Illustrative photo of'
displayRules.restrictions: Never presented as the provider's team, completed work, customer results or before-and-after evidence.

unmappedServices: A catalog service with no entry here shows no illustrative photo. Suitable CC0 photos were not found for pressure-washing, window-cleaning or tree-trimming on 2026-11-18.
